g.text: The pointer enters a page: who decides the cursor
pointer moves from Back onto the page
hit-testing stops at the page's host:
get_cursor(): .view hosts a page, so it asks

later moves inside the page keep the chrome's hover on .view:
the chrome never asks again, so the cursor stays hidden,
and a link never shows the hand
install(): the chrome's provider is a WindowShell
host changed: clear the page left,
